note: Ford County, IL publishes its zoning district map only as PDF (county ordinance refers to an official district map; Gibson City's zoning map and Paxton's zoning map are PDFs). The county's GIS is an assessor viewer (ford-il.bhamaps.com, which returns AccessDenied on its REST directory) and a Sidwell Portico viewer; neither exposes a public zoning district service. No official zoning FeatureServer/MapServer was found for the county or for Paxton or Gibson City. Only third-party parcel/zoning products (Regrid, Rockford Map Publishers) carry zoning, and they are not official.
